repo.name: vscode-ansible
repo.description: Ansible IDE extension: auto-completion and integrating quality assurance tools like ansible-lint, ansible syntax check, yamllint, molecule and ansible-test.

readme.summary: This is a marketing overview page that defers all actual documentation to an external site, making it nearly useless as a standalone README.
readme.top_issue: No installation instructions, examples, or configuration details — everything is externalized to docs.ansible.com, leaving the README as a feature list only.
